A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Hofmeister effect is a powerful tool to tune the supramolecular structure and the resulting properties of peptide amphiphile gels.

The main takeaway from our work is that
specific-ion effects can be utilized to tune self-assembly and the materials properties of supramolecular hydrogel systems.
the specific-ion effect is not only limited to the biological systems, but can be extended to synthetic systems as well.
